description: Complete a task with a single call using poster's private key. Internally: prepare_payment → sign → submit to Hedera → complete task. Returns { taskId, paymentTxId, completedAt }. Task must be in 'delivered' status. Convenience tool — eliminates 3-step round-trip.

posterPrivateKey.description: Poster's private key (DER hex or 0x-prefixed ECDSA hex)

name: complete_task_with_key
